mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing dronedarone levels, while both agents have antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for dronedarone toxicity signs (QT prolongation, bradycardia, heart failure) and bleeding; consider separating administration or reducing turmeric supplementation; counsel patient on bleeding precautions.
